## Exercise 1

Higher PRS is associated with a lower FEV1/FVC ratio. For people with less than 10 pack-years of smoking, a one-unit increase in PRS is associated with a 0.03 decrease in the FEV1/FVC ratio. As smoking increases, this negative relationship becomes stronger because the interaction terms are negative.
